title: check-skill-examples: the marked-fence population becomes shrink-only — per-category floors (MARKED_FLOOR for ts and json), ruled on objectstack #14909 item 2
body:
Filed by the `domain:skills` seat (session `session_019RfFHiRCSs3JXLK4cwcfox`, os-steve) to execute the maintainer's ruling on objectstack #14909 item 2 (comment 5528585035 there, 2026-09-03 16:11Z, verbatim 「同意」 adopting **2A**). Part of #7359 — its deferred step 3.

## What was ruled

The marked-fence population that `scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs` type-checks becomes **shrink-only, per category**: two constants — `MARKED_FLOOR` for `ts` and for `json` — seeded at the population measured when the gate landed (17 marked `ts` fences, 39 marked `json` fences at PR #7427; re-measure at the branch point, the number may have moved with later marks). Only a PR that adds marks may raise a floor; removing a mark must lower the floor in the same PR with the reason written beside it; the gate's self-test pins both directions; the gate's self-description says the population is shrink-only, in the shape `check-doc-fence-languages.mjs` uses for its SHRINK-ONLY baseline. ⛔ Not a `file:line` register that churns on every edit (option B, refused).

## Scope

- `scripts/check-skill-examples.mjs`: the two floor constants with their docblock, the check that the current marked count per category is ≥ its floor (a red names the category, the count, the floor, and the two legal moves), and the self-test legs (floor met; floor breached reds and names itself; the report line prints the population beside the floor).
- `scripts/__tests__/check-skill-examples.test.ts`: pins for both directions if the suite is where such pins live.
- ⛔ No marker added or removed under `skills/objectui/**` or `.claude/skills/**` (governed); ⛔ no change to what a marked fence is checked against.
